title: Pairwise independent matrix
statement: For natural numbers $\ell$ and $n$ satisfying $n \le 2^\ell - 1$, define the $\ell\times n$ matrix over the field with two elements whose entry in row $i$ and column $j$ is the $i$th coordinate of the pairwise independent column associated with $j$.
caveat: The construction of the pairwise independent columns is not included, so their coordinates cannot be described more explicitly from this statement.
